macros.name: ekvchangeset
macros.doc: Replaces the current ⟨set⟩ with ⟨new-set⟩, so for the rest of the current \ekvset call that call behaves as if it was called with \ekvset{⟨new-set⟩}.

macros.name: ekvcompile
macros.doc: This macro defines ⟨cs⟩ to be a fast way to set the given ⟨key⟩=⟨value⟩ list in ⟨set⟩.

macros.name: ekvcompile*
macros.doc: This macro defines ⟨cs⟩ to be a fast way to set the given ⟨key⟩=⟨value⟩ list in ⟨set⟩.

macros.name: ekvcsvloop
macros.doc: This loops over the comma separated items in ⟨csv-list⟩ and, after stripping spaces from either end of ⟨item⟩ and removing at most one set of outer braces, leaves \unexpanded{⟨code⟩{⟨item⟩}} for each list item in the input stream.

macros.name: ekvdef
macros.doc: Defines a Val-⟨key⟩ in a ⟨set⟩ to expand to ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: ekvdefNoVal
macros.doc: Defines a NoVal-⟨key⟩ in ⟨set⟩ to expand to ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: ekvdefunknown
macros.doc: Execute ⟨code⟩ if an undefined Val-⟨key⟩ is encountered while parsing in ⟨set⟩.

macros.name: ekvdefunknownNoVal
macros.doc: With this you can let expkv execute ⟨code⟩ if an unknown NoVal-⟨key⟩ was encountered.

macros.name: ekvifdefinedset
macros.doc: This macro tests whether ⟨set⟩ is defined (which it is if at least one key was defined for it).

macros.name: ekvlet
macros.doc: Let the Val-⟨key⟩ in ⟨set⟩ to ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: ekvletkv
macros.doc: Copies the definition such that Val-⟨key⟩ in ⟨set⟩ behaves like ⟨key2⟩ of ⟨set2⟩.

macros.name: ekvletNoVal
macros.doc: Let the NoVal-⟨key⟩ in ⟨set⟩ to ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: ekvoptarg
macros.doc: This macro will expandably check for a following optional argument in brackets ([]).

macros.name: ekvoptargTF
macros.doc: This macro is similar to \ekvoptarg but will result in ⟨true⟩{⟨optional⟩}⟨mandatory⟩ or ⟨false⟩{⟨mandatory⟩} instead of placing a default value.

macros.name: ekvparse
macros.doc: This macro parses the ⟨key⟩=⟨value⟩ list and provides NoVal-⟨key⟩s to ⟨code1⟩ as a single argument and Val-⟨key⟩s with their corresponding ⟨value⟩ as two arguments to ⟨code2⟩.

macros.name: ekvredirectunknown
macros.doc: This is a short cut to set up a special \ekvdefunknown-rule for ⟨set⟩ that will check each set in the comma separated ⟨set-list⟩ for an unknown Val-⟨key⟩.

macros.name: ekvset
macros.doc: This macro parses the ⟨key⟩=⟨value⟩ list and checks for defined ⟨key⟩s that are in ⟨set⟩.

macros.name: ekvsetdef
macros.doc: Defines the macro ⟨cs⟩ to be a shortcut for \ekvset{⟨set⟩}.

macros.name: ekvsetSneaked
macros.doc: This behaves like \ekvset in which \ekvsneak was immediately called.

macros.name: ekvsneak
macros.doc: Puts ⟨after⟩ after the effects of \ekvset (without cancelling the current \ekvset call).
